name: std::bitset<N>::set
intro:
Sets all bits to true or sets one bit to specified value.

1) Sets all bits to true.

2) Sets the bit at position pos to the value value.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
pos

 -

 the position (counting from 0, i.e. from least significant to most significant) of the bit to set


 value

 -

 the value to set the bit to

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: 2) Throws std::out_of_range if pos does not correspond to a valid bit position.

summary: Sets all bits to true or sets one bit to specified value.
